title: Datasheet for an open CPTAC proteomics dataset
context: Extends coverage to proteomics with an open CPTAC dataset. Binding cancer guardrails apply: open-access / aggregate / de-identified data only; controlled-access (dbGaP, EGA, ICGC DACO, individual-level biobanks) and any identifiable patient data are OUT OF SCOPE; COSMIC/OncoKB are non-commercial/custom (flag, never treat as open); no medical advice; provenance on every assertion. Open tier must be verified before any documentation; controlled or identifiable CPTAC content is out of scope.
objective: Produce a gate-passed, provenance-backed datasheet for an open-tier CPTAC proteomics dataset and get it accepted (or submitted with the blocker surfaced).
acceptanceCriteria: CPTAC dataset confirmed open-access with cited license/terms (open tier verified); passed gate-004 with the artifact committed; controlled/identifiable content excluded.
Complete data dictionary + access-tier + identifiability assessment + Datasheet + valid Croissant; completeness >= 90/100; provenance citation per assertion.
Provenance + license snapshot recorded (committed copy + SHA-256 + Wayback URL), including the required CPTAC citation.
Accepted upstream with acceptance artifact -- or submitted with the blocker surfaced.
